title: The Brazilian ship Taubaté is attacked by a German warplane in the Mediterranean Sea.
text: Brazil officially entered World War II on August 22, 1942, when it declared war against the Axis powers, including Germany and Italy. On February 8, 1943, Brazil formally joined the Allies upon signing the Declaration by United Nations.

title: The Estádio Presidente Vargas is opened at Fortaleza.
text: The Estádio Presidente Vargas, nicknamed PV, is a multi-purpose stadium located in Fortaleza, Ceará, Brazil. It is currently used mostly for association football matches and also sometimes for American football matches.

title: Oscar Lorenzo Fernández's nationalist-themed opera, Malazarte, to a libretto by José Pereira Graça Aranha, receives its première at the Teatro Municipal, Rio de Janeiro, eight years after it was completed.
text: Oscar Lorenzo Fernández was a Brazilian composer of Spanish descent. He was born and died in Rio de Janeiro.
